{{Quote|Excuse the mess. Lost most of my unit to an army of crazed aliens. We're all that's left of Operations Group Three.|Colonel Grang|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Special Operations Group Three''', more commonly known as '''Operations Group Three''', was one of five [[Operations Group|Special Operations Groups]] sent by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] into the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]] in hopes of locating and freeing the [[Dread Masters]]. Operations Group Three was led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Grang]], and was stationed in the [[Maximum Security Section]] to sow chaos and clear the way while [[Special Operations Group One|Groups One]] and [[Special Operations Group Two|Two]] continued onward into [[the Tomb]]. However, Colonel Grang's men broke open several [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vaults and unintentionally unleashed the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which spread quickly throughout the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Grang's men were forced to retreat to the [[Imperial frontline camp]].<ref name="TOR" />
